Author: Shekhar Kumar Yadav

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 53519 of 2023
Applicant :- Jayendra
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Jitendra Pal Singh,Pavan Kumar Kushwaha,Pradeep Kumar Singh,Tha

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Mohammad Waseem
Hon'ble Shekhar Kumar Yadav,J.
1.

Heard Sri Jitendra Pal Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Mohd. Waseem, learned counsel for the informant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State of U.P and perused the material available on record.

2. By way of the instant application, the applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.571 of 2023 under Sections 376(2)n, 452, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 67 of IT Act, Police Station- Baheri, District- Bareilly.

3. As per prosecution story, on 29.5.2023 the victim was alone in the house then at 9:00 pm the applicant came in her house and on the pistol point committed rape with her and also made video and threatened to victim for viral the video.
Jayendra vs State Of U.P. on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59280854/
1 4.
Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The applicant has not committed any offence as alleged in the impugned FIR.

He submits that the actual fact of the case is that prior to alleged incident, the father of the victim taken Rs.40,000/- from the father of the applicant as borrow for the period of one month and after one month when the applicant demanded money from father of victim, then through victim falsely implicated the applicant in the present case.
He submits that as per medical report, there is no injury found on the body of the victim.
There is major contradiction in the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C.
Several other submissions in order to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against the applicant have also been placed forth before the Court.
The circumstances which, according to the counsel, led to the false implication of the accused have also been touched upon at length.
It has been assured on behalf of the applicant that he is ready to cooperate with the process of law and shall faithfully make himself available before the court whenever required.
He submits that the applicant is languishing in jail since 1.10.2023 having no criminal history.

5. Per contra, learned counsel for the informant has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and has submitted that the victim has supported the prosecution story in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and brother of the victim in his statement has stated that the applicant himself has sent photos and videos of the victim to him thereafter, marriage of the victim got cancelled,
hence, the applicant is not entitled for bail and his bail application is liable to be rejected.
6. Learned A.G.A. has adopted contention of the learned counsel for the informant.
7. Considered the rival submissions, perused the material brought on record and the enormity of the offence.
No good ground is made out for bail.
8. Consequently, the instant bail application is rejected.

Order Date :- 13.8.2024 Krishna*
